 Order

1. This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 28.4.2023 in connection with Crime No. 133/2023, registered at Police Station Shahpura District Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), and 376(3) of the IPC and Sections 16 read with 17 and 5 read with 6 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that no allegation of commission of rape is made against the applicant.
He is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case of rape.

Applicant has accompanied the prosecutrix along with main accused person but has not committed any act of kidnapping or commission of rape.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the State as well as counsel for the objector have opposed the bail application and submitted that no allegation against the applicant was made as applicant was threatening the prosecutrix and after threatening her had taken her to Court for recording of her statement.
Applicant is also having 7 criminal records.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Perused the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C..
Prosecutrix is aged about 15 years and 8 months.
Consent of prosecutrix is immaterial.
Applicant is having criminal records and as many as 7 criminal cases are registered against the applicant.
There are chances that applicant will influence the prosecutrix or the witnesses in the case.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
7. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in the Court.
8. Counsel for the objector is directed to keep the prosecutrix present in the Court on the date fixed for recording of her statement.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
